name: SendPortal

evidence.newsletter: F02: newsletters and marketing campaigns to tagged audiences with scheduled broadcasts

line: Self-hosted newsletters and marketing campaigns using your email provider.

free.text: Free MIT software; supply a server, database and sender

cells.newsletters: Yes, broadcasts to tagged subscriber audiences
